_about: The Nights of Straparola, volume 1 of 2, translated by W. G. Waters (London: Lawrence and Bullen, 1894). The Italian tale collection (1550-53) where several fairy-tale types first appear in print; some tales are bawdy. Volume 2 is not on Gutenberg yet. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).
_author: Giovanni Francesco Straparola; tr. W. G. Waters
